mapper.sql: select c.chapter_id, c.course_id, c.course_name, c.chapter_title, c.chapter_intro, c.order_num, c.resource_count, c.attachment_url, c.attachment_name, c.attachment_size_mb, c.status, c.del_flag, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, course.teacher_user_id from edu_course_chapter c left join edu_course course on course.course_id = c.course_id
mapper.select:
c.del_flag = '0'
and c.course_name like concat('%', #{courseName}, '%')
and c.chapter_title like concat('%', #{chapterTitle}, '%')
and c.status = #{status}
and course.teacher_user_id = cast(#{createBy} as signed)
order by c.course_id asc, c.order_num asc, c.chapter_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into edu_course_chapter(course_id, course_name, chapter_title, chapter_intro, order_num, resource_count, attachment_url, attachment_name, attachment_size_mb, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{courseId}, #{courseName}, #{chapterTitle}, #{chapterIntro}, #{orderNum}, #{resourceCount}, #{attachmentUrl}, #{attachmentName}, #{attachmentSizeMb}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update edu_course_chapter set course_id = #{courseId}, course_name = #{courseName}, chapter_title = #{chapterTitle}, chapter_intro = #{chapterIntro}, order_num = #{orderNum}, resource_count = #{resourceCount}, attachment_url = #{attachmentUrl}, attachment_name = #{attachmentName}, attachment_size_mb = #{attachmentSizeMb}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where chapter_id = #{chapterId}
